risks.name: Equipment breakdown
risks.reason: Daily work depends on key machinery and systems, so a breakdown stops work and can be costly to repair. (based on: ovens, refrigerators and mixers)

risks.name: Electrical fire
risks.reason: Equipment that runs for long hours puts constant load on the electrical system, and faults can start a fire. (based on: mixers and refrigerators)

risks.name: Employee injury at work
risks.reason: Staff working with heat, sharp tools or heavy lifting can be hurt by burns, cuts, slips or strains. (based on: 8 employees and ovens)

risks.name: Employee theft or fraud
risks.reason: Staff with access to cash and stock have the opportunity to steal or falsify records. (based on: 8 employees and cash handling)

risks.name: Forced closure after premises damage
risks.reason: If the premises cannot be used after an incident, trading stops because there is no alternative site. (based on: a single location and physical premises)

risks.name: Power, gas or water outage
risks.reason: Cooking, cold storage and sales systems cannot run without power, gas or water, so an outage halts work. (based on: refrigerators and ovens)

risks.name: Customer or visitor injury on premises
risks.reason: Customers and visitors on the premises can be hurt by slips, trips or falls. (based on: customers visiting the premises and physical premises)

risks.name: Theft, burglary and vandalism
risks.reason: Stock, cash and equipment kept on the premises can be stolen or damaged by intruders or vandals. (based on: cash handling)

risks.name: Flood, storm and water damage
risks.reason: Premises, stock and equipment can be damaged by flooding, storms or burst pipes. (based on: a flood-prone location)

risks.name: Loss or damage of goods in delivery
risks.reason: Goods sent to customers can be lost, spoiled or damaged on the way, outside the business's control. (based on: delivery)

risks.name: Fire from cooking and baking equipment
risks.reason: Ovens, fryers, grills and gas burners create sustained high heat and open flame, which are ignition sources. (based on: ovens)

risks.name: Refrigeration failure and stock spoilage
risks.reason: Perishable stock depends on cold storage, and a failure can spoil it quickly. (based on: refrigerators)

risks.name: Food-borne illness and allergen incidents
risks.reason: Contamination or undeclared allergens in food can make customers ill. (based on: bread, cakes and pastries)

risks.name: Payment fraud and chargebacks
risks.reason: Card and online payments are targets for fraud, stolen cards and false disputes. (based on: card payments)

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Equipment breakdown
findings.explanation: This is a relevant risk for a bakery. Why it matters: Daily work depends on key machinery and systems, so a breakdown stops work and can be costly to repair. (based on: ovens, refrigerators and mixers). No policy wording about this risk was found in the documents analysed, so this is a potential gap. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
